scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact radial monomial moments, an error-controlled Mellin smoothing formula, uniform Riemann summation, gamma nonvanishing, and Laplace uniqueness.

scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a strictly positive continuous periodic radial log-profile and a power exponent greater than minus one.
It determines boundary rescaling limits and scalar-normalized phase rigidity, not kernel zeros or boundary traces of arbitrary analytic functions.
No nonperiodic, nonsmooth-periodic, nonradial or several-complex-variable extension is asserted.
Historical-priority comparison is based on accessible inspected papers and searchable research records, not an exhaustive literature proof.
title: Complete log-periodic boundary tangents of radial Bergman kernels
